nodes.description: Address of the contract admin, assigned from msg.sender in the constructor; bypasses the burn/fee logic and gates withdraw.
Burn fee percentage (2) applied on every sell/transfer.
Boolean flag marking whether the first transfer already happened.
Block number recorded on the first transfer, used for the anti-bot buy limit window.
Mapping of account balances, mutated by _transfer and addBalance.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances.
Total token supply, reduced by the burn on each transfer.
External admin-only function that sends the contract balance to msg.sender.
Internal transfer routine that computes the burn, enforces the early-block buy limit, updates balances and total supply.
Public transferFrom that moves tokens and decreases the allowance via SafeMath.
Public transfer that forwards _msgSender as the sender to _transfer.
View function returning block.number - firstBlock, exposing the anti-bot window state.
Internal minting helper that increases a balance and the total supply.
Internal helper that writes the allowances mapping.
msg.sender as returned by _msgSender(); controls transfers, allowance spending, admin checks and receives withdrawn funds.
msg.sender.transfer(address(this).balance) external value call performed in withdraw.
Arithmetic burn computation amount.mul(burnFee).div(100) and amount.sub(amountBurn) driving balance and supply updates.
Amount argument of _transfer used in the buy-limit require and burn math.
Local holding the amount actually credited to the recipient after burn.
Local holding the computed burn amount removed from total supply.

edges.reason: withdraw is gated by require(msg.sender == admin), so msg.sender controls privileged fund withdrawal.
msg.sender is the destination of the external value transfer in withdraw, enabling reentrant/recipient-controlled callbacks.
_msgSender() from transfer/transferFrom flows into _transfer as the sender whose balance is debited.
firstBlock participates in the block.number < firstBlock + 20 buy-limit branch that restricts early buyers.
burnFee is multiplied into the amount inside the burn arithmetic operation.
The amount parameter feeds the mul/div/sub burn computation and the amountLimit require.
The burn arithmetic determines the debit/re-credit values written into _balances.
The computed burn is subtracted from _totalSupply.
amountRec is credited to the recipient balance in _balances.
amountBurn is subtracted from _totalSupply, permanently reducing supply.
_transfer writes debit and credit entries into the _balances mapping.
_transfer mutates _totalSupply through the burn subtraction.
transferFrom invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transfer invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom reads and deducts _allowances[sender][msg.sender], a spender-controlled authorization check.
_approve writes the spender amount into the _allowances mapping.
addBalance increases the target account entry in _balances.
addBalance increases _totalSupply when minting initial liquidity.
getFirstBlockTime exposes block.number - firstBlock, leaking the anti-bot window state.
_transfer reads and sets the firstTransfer flag on the first executed transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter has no independent semantics and is fully consumed by the _transfer burn/limit logic, so it should be folded into the _transfer function node.
amountRec is a transient intermediate value produced inside _transfer before being written to balances; it carries no distinct behavior and merges into _transfer.
amountBurn exists only as the output of the burn arithmetic operation and directly feeds the supply/balance updates, so it merges into the unsafe arithmetic operation node.
